expectations.text: am.json is valid JSON with exactly the eight keys of en.json
expectations.evidence: keys: save, cancel, delete_confirm, files_count, welcome_back, search_placeholder, error_network, order_delivered

expectations.text: Every placeholder ({name}, {count}, {firstName}, {time}) appears unchanged in its string in am.json
Every value in am.json is Amharic in Fidel script, none left in English
The sentence strings in am.json use Ethiopic punctuation (። or ?) with no :: and no space before ። or ፣
expectations.evidence: sentences: {name} ይሰረዝ? ይህ ሊቀለበስ አይችልም። መገናኘት አልተቻለም። የኢንተርኔት ግንኙነትዎን ያረጋግጡና እንደገና ይሞክሩ። ትዕዛዝዎ {time} ላይ ደርሷል።

expectations.text: welcome_back uses a polite or gender-neutral greeting (e.g. መጡ), not the informal መጣህ or መጣሽ
